owner_rule: OWNER RULE 2026-10-04: speculative-decoding acceptance and the DeepSeek-V4.1 GPU decode baseline must come from PUBLISHED THIRD-PARTY sources (MLCommons, LMSys/SGLang, vLLM, model vendors, NVIDIA/AMD, ...), never from our own measurement. OWNER CORRECTION: cite this registry instead of re-researching.

decisions.decision: DeepSeek-V4.1 composition default tau = 4.159, the owner 6-class workload blend (harmonic, greedy, gamma 5) in results/speculative/v41_mtp_acceptance_qualified_20261003/blend_owner6.json; the published V4.1 value 3.8879 and the published V4.1 gamma-5 range 3.43-4.32 are kept as a SENSITIVITY (OT_TAU_SOURCE=third_party). Qwen3-8B keeps the third-party derived 3.1445.
decisions.reason: OWNER: a single GSM8K dataset (the 3.8879 primary) makes no sense as the headline workload, and several published sources are V4-Flash, not V4.1.
decisions.supersedes: the 2026-10-04 owner rule's DS default (published 3.8879); the third-party figures below are unchanged

convention: tau = mean tokens committed per verify step INCLUDING the bonus token (EAGLE/DSpark 'accepted length')

qwen3_8b.composition_block: The Qwen ROM DSpark composition (results/rtl/qwen_dspark_system_20261004/ctx8k/step_composed_ctx8k.json) verifies a block of 4 positions = 3 draft tokens + bonus (S=3 drafter slots, n_emit 4 at a=3), so it takes tau at 3 draft tokens; values at 4 and 5 draft tokens are listed for a gamma-4/5 configuration.

mismatch: draft length: published only at gamma 7; truncated to 3 by a constant-conditional model (DSpark's per-position conditional acceptance is published as stable across positions 1-7)
dataset: 9 public benchmarks, not the owner 6-class mix

3.basis: DERIVED from published DSpark Table 1 (Qwen3-8B, gamma 7, T=1.0): per benchmark solve constant conditional acceptance r from tau7 = 1 + sum_{i<=7} r^i, then tau3 = 1 + sum_{i<=3} r^i; equal weight over the 9 benchmarks (3 math, 3 code, 3 chat)

4.basis: DERIVED from published DSpark Table 1 (Qwen3-8B, gamma 7, T=1.0): per benchmark solve constant conditional acceptance r from tau7 = 1 + sum_{i<=7} r^i, then tau4 = 1 + sum_{i<=4} r^i; equal weight over the 9 benchmarks (3 math, 3 code, 3 chat)

5.basis: DERIVED from published DSpark Table 1 (Qwen3-8B, gamma 7, T=1.0): per benchmark solve constant conditional acceptance r from tau7 = 1 + sum_{i<=7} r^i, then tau5 = 1 + sum_{i<=5} r^i; equal weight over the 9 benchmarks (3 math, 3 code, 3 chat)

range.basis: derived k=3 per-benchmark spread (Arena-Hard low, GSM8K high)

truncation_cross_check.reading: on a published DSpark curve the constant-conditional truncation UNDER-estimates tau at k=3 by ~7-8%, so the derived Qwen primary is conservative

mismatch: EAGLE-3 drafter (DSpark is +27-31% over Eagle3 per the DSpark paper)

superseded_self_measured.note: our measurement; SUPERSEDED 2026-10-04 by the owner rule

mismatch: dataset GSM8K (reasoning) only, greedy, short outputs (<=1,024)
